decision: REJECT v12.2 four-model exam-page redesign; ROLL BACK to the v12.1 exam-run structure (commit d356963), keep only the emblem change + RTL arrow fix
user_feedback: اون ساختار قبل از تغییرات صفحه ازمون ... اون رفرنس خوبیه / پاسخبرگ رو آوردی گذاشتی بالا کلا قاتی پاتی شده / بعدی نوک پیکان باید به سمت چپ باشه برای قبلی به سمت راست

reference_of_record.exam_run: chapter_toolbar 52dp (X | title+6dp progress | timer | flag) → ScrollView question stem + 4 choice_list_item cards → feedback bottom sheet → quiet tool chips → ONE full-width purple CTA + two 48dp squares + lesson_skip
reference_of_record.answer_sheet: BOTTOM SHEET #paletteSheet opened from #answerSheetBtn or the flag button — never inline above the question
reference_of_record.answer_key: BOTTOM SHEET #keySheet with keyTestSheet / keyDescSheet, per-kind policy; never mixed into the question body

what_was_wrong_in_v12_2: a 20-bubble inline answer-sheet card was inserted ABOVE the stem, between the step row and the subject chip — it crowded and confused the question body
four swapped footers and a quick 4-bubble row duplicated the option cards and made the page incoherent
the model picker and model badges added review scaffolding to a page that was already accepted
directional arrows stayed LTR: NEXT pointed right, PREVIOUS/BACK pointed left

rtl_arrow_rule.statement: In an RTL (Persian/Arabic) interface NEXT/FORWARD points LEFT (←) and PREVIOUS/BACK points RIGHT (→)

applied.all_other_arrows: [dir=rtl] mirrors LTR-authored ic_arrow_* icons; [dir=ltr] mirrors the three explicitly RTL-authored ones

chinese_repo_crosscheck.name: 学之思在线考试系统 (xzs / uexam)
findings: the answering page keeps a CLEAN question body: el-card per question, QuestionEdit for the options
question-number tags + 剩余时间 (remaining time) live in a separate compact sticky header row, NOT as a big card inside the question body
one primary 提交 (Submit) button at the end of the paper, plus 取消
answer / 解析 / correct answer are shown AFTER submission in read.vue and QuestionAnswerShow.vue, and in 错题本 (wrong-question book) — not during the exam
chinese_repo_crosscheck.conclusion: confirms the v12.1 shape: answer sheet and answer key are separate sheets/panels, the question body stays uncluttered, and correctness is revealed after the exam
chinese_repo_crosscheck.usage: UNDERSTANDING / cross-check only — no code, assets or layout copied into this design prototype

sources_policy: decoded APK resources remain the source of truth for the Mimo skin; web + Chinese repo are cross-checks only; screenshots VISUAL_CROSSCHECK_ONLY
